{"approach":"Two independent changes. (1) Note: Flyway V3 adds a nullable link.note VARCHAR(280). Link gets a note component (null for older links) and a withNote wither; CreateLinkRequest gets an optional note with @Size(max = 280), so a longer note fails bean validation (400 validation-failed) before the service runs. The redirect path (cache entries hold only the original URL) is untouched, so the note never leaves the management API. (2) CSV: StatsController gets GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv producing text/csv. {"summary":"Draft API note for the link note and the clicks CSV: request and response fields, limits, problem types, curl examples, and the additive V3 migration.","files":[{"path":"docs/api/link-notes-and-csv.md","newContent":"# Link notes and the clicks CSV

Two additions to the management API. Both need an `X-API-Key`, and both apply only to links the
key owns.

## Notes on links
`POST /api/v1/links` takes an optional `note`: plain text, at most 280 characters. The note is
stored with the link and returned in the link body on create (`201`) and on
`GET /api/v1/links/{code}`. It is `null` when none was given, and for links created before this
change.

```bash
curl -s -X POST localhost:8085/api/v1/links \
  -H 'X-API-Key: <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url":"https://example.com/spring","note":"spring campaign flyer"}'
```

- A note longer than 280 characters gets `400` with type `/problems/validation-failed`.
- The note is for the owner only. The public redirect (`GET /{code}`) never returns it.
- A note can't be changed after the link is created.

## Daily clicks as CSV
`GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv` returns `text/csv`, as an attachment named
`<code>-clicks.csv`:

```
day,clicks
2026-03-01,0
2026-03-02,2
2026-03-03,0
```

- There is one row per UTC day of the range, oldest first. Days without clicks are `0`.
- The rules are those of `GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats`:
  - `from` and `to` are optional ISO dates, and both ends are inclusive;
  - the default is the last 30 days, and the maximum is 90 days;
  - a bad range gets `400` with type `/problems/invalid-stats-range`;
  - an unknown link, or another key's, gets `404` with type `/problems/link-not-found`.
- Unique visitors, referrers and user agents are only in the JSON stats.

```bash
curl -s -H 'X-API-Key: <key>' \
  'localhost:8085/api/v1/links/aB3xY9k/stats.csv?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-31' -o clicks.csv
```

## Schema
Flyway `V3__link_note.sql` adds a nullable `link.note VARCHAR(280)`. In PostgreSQL that is a
catalog-only change, so the table isn't rewritten and the previous version keeps working.
"}]}
